title: Want do you want in a map

replies.author: Raikkou
replies.body:
Hope you can make something good out of this, if you want me to change anything or so, tell me

Gamemode: DTM
Map Theme: weather (storm clouds, Rain)
Colour Pallet: Gray, White, Black, Blue
Game play(fast paced or slow paced ECT): Slow paced, I like maps where you have time to build up good defences
Structures: iron deposit (hidden diamonds), 1 monument
Loadout: leather armor + iron sword + 32 Log + 64 Stone + 64 Glass + 3 Gapples + 32 Steaks
Resource Supplies (yes or no, if yes which resources): Iron and diamonds?
Drops from kills (yes or no, if yes which things) gapples, stone, wood, things collected from the map, iron/dian armor and tools
